text: The battery room ventilation shall be monitored by an airflow switch; on loss of ventilation the battery charger shall change to float voltage (boost charging inhibited) and an alarm shall be raised; hydrogen detectors shall alarm at 10 % LEL and trip the charger at 25 % LEL; the fans, motors and detectors shall be certified for Zone 2 IIC T1 in the room and the room shall be considered per IEC 60079-10-1; no ignition source or non-certified equipment is permitted in the room.
